evidence.note: The data description documents a null result for a domain that only resolves locally, but the item schema declares a non-nullable string.
ensure_domains_reside_only_locally returned a one-item list whose item was an explicit null on both the direct and bridged routes; docs/api/source-audit.md#runtime-observations-2026-10-15-dns-slice

has_local_authority returned [].error as an explicit null on both the direct and bridged routes when the authority check succeeded, although the pinned schema declares a string returned only on failure; docs/api/source-audit.md#runtime-observations-2026-10-15-dns-slice

is_alias_available returned resolver as an explicit null on both the direct and bridged routes when no PowerDNS resolver setting exists, although the pinned schema declares a string; docs/api/source-audit.md#runtime-observations-2026-10-15-dns-slice

The documented list item is a oneOf of record, control and comment objects whose fields are all optional; the generated union keeps the first matching branch and would drop text_b64 from control and comment lines, so the branches are merged into one object with every documented field optional.
